beats.text: If you live a **modern** life, read this.

beats.label: Who they tested
beats.text: **1,015** healthy adults in **35** communities, rural to urban, across **12** countries.

beats.label: Shift 1
beats.text: More industrialized life went with **less diverse** gut bacteria.

beats.label: Shift 2
beats.text: A gut **stress marker** ran over **8x** higher, and a gut antibody more than **double.**

beats.label: Shift 3
beats.text: Their microbe networks looked **less stable,** with fewer backups for breaking down **fiber.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: One **snapshot** in time. Diet and lifestyle couldn't be separated, and harm to **health** isn't shown.
